stem: A room schedule says flower week two, but several plants show less reproductive development than the rest. What is the best record?
choices: Record the visible developmental distribution and keep the schedule as separate context
All plants are flower week two because the schedule controls biology
Change the cultivar name for the lagging plants
Ignore the lagging plants because they are a minority
rationale: Developmental stage should be supported by observable morphology; schedule timing is useful context but not proof that every plant is biologically identical.
